meta.title: COF — Character Open File
meta.description: One open file for an AI character: personality, looks, voice, 3D, motion, memories, a psyche, agent files — with its rights and consent built in.
meta.og_description: Complete AI characters in one open file — portable, with their rights.

hero.sub: Complete AI characters in one open file — portable, with their rights.

lede: An open file format that bundles everything that defines an AI character — personality, looks, voice, 3D, motion, agent skills, memories and a psyche — with its rights and consent built in. The same file opens in a chat app, an image generator, ComfyUI, a game engine or an agent.
status: Now: 1.2.2, 15 November 2026 — the builder keeps everything it does not model, agent hosts in cof-cli (one memory, two homes), undated memories in the explorer (notes). Before: 1.2.1, 8 November — Character.AI import; 1.2, 8 November — a psyche; 1.1, 30 October — memories; 1.0, 17 October. Every 1.x file stays valid and readable by every 1.x tool.

work_intro: Two short films made for 1.2.2, with real files and real tools, nothing staged.

films.p: Clara is exported to OpenClaw and answers from the memories her file carries. Told something new, the agent writes a note; cof memory add brings it back into her file as a lived, personal memory. Exported to Hermes, which had never met her, she remembers this morning's train.

A character is more than a prompt. Her psyche — eleven kinds of nodes, each tied to the memory, person or place it comes from — explored, played through time, written in the builder, then turned into the SOUL.md an agent reads.

sections.alt: A .cof holds personality, looks, voice, poses and motion, identity weights, 3D, agent files and rights
sections.p: A ZIP archive with a manifest: the character's identity, its elements in eight categories — personality (a Character Card V3 inside, a psyche, free text), appearance, identity weights, 3D, voice, postures, motion, memories — a library of agent files, and its rights. Almost everything is optional; what goes in is checked.

sections.alt: Clara Mercier at 29, in manga style, at 65 and as a near-future combatant: four presets of one file
sections.p: A preset is a ready-to-use combination: one personality, one look, one voice, one age. Switch the language or the age, and the rest follows.

sections.h: A past, not just a description
sections.alt: The explorer's memory graph of Clara at 65: a period, nine moments on a time axis, the people and places they link to
sections.p: Moments and periods of a life, each with when, where, with whom, how it felt then and now, how clearly it comes back, and what the character would rather not tell. What it lives with a user is written back into the same file — and leaves with it. Read more.

sections.h: An inner life, and what it holds on to
sections.alt: The explorer's psyche graph of Clara: values, wants, fears, beliefs and a wound, grouped under the memories they come from
sections.p: Values, beliefs, wants, fears, wounds, tastes and habits as a graph of short nodes, each with a strength, a time span and the memory it comes from. People, places and objects are named once, shared by memories and psyche. Read more.

sections.alt: A rights card: voice cloning no, training no, redistribution no, commercial use personal and non-profit, AI disclosure yes
sections.p: Permissions, consent when a real person is depicted, and provenance are part of the file. Every preset declares an age; nudity or intimate content with a minor makes a file invalid, not merely tagged.

sections.alt: Clara Mercier and Martien, two characters in one file, each with its own rights
sections.p: A cast travels together, and each character keeps its own looks, voice, presets and rights.

sections.h: Make it once. Use it everywhere.
sections.alt: Create with the builder, an AI agent or an import; use in the explorer, ComfyUI, chat apps and agents
sections.p: Create with the builder, an AI agent or an import; use it in the explorer, ComfyUI, chat apps and agent hosts. cof validate checks ages, rights, hashes and scripts.

cai: Drop your CAI Tools or PersonaText export, check three things, download one .cof: your character, and your conversations as its memories, kept private. Then take it further than a backup — looks, a voice, presets, a psyche. Everything happens in your browser. Save your characters →
embrace: A .cof contains a valid Character Card V3 and exports to a ccv3 PNG card, a card JSON, SOUL.md / IDENTITY.md, an OpenClaw workspace and a Hermes profile; a VRM avatar inside is a plain file. Existing tools have nothing to rewrite. What fits in the file, compared →
